description_en: Retrieves the health check status of a listener and its forwarding rules
description_zh: 查询监听及其转发规则的健康检查状态
name: GetListenerHealthStatus

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to include the health check results for forwarding rules.

true

false (default)
parameters.help_zh:
是否包含转发规则的检查结果。取值：

true：是。
false（默认值）：否
parameters.name: include_rule

parameters.help_en:
The token used to retrieve the next page of results.

You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request.

For subsequent requests, set this parameter to the value of NextToken returned in the previous response
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。
如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Range: 1 to 30. Default: 20
parameters.help_zh: 分批次查询时每次显示的最大条目数。取值范围：1~30，默认值为20
parameters.name: max_results

schema.description_en: The health check statuses of the listener and its associated forwarding rules
schema.description_zh: 查询监听及其相应配置的转发规则的健康检查状态

ListenerHealthStatus.description_en: A list of health check statuses for the server groups that are associated with the listener
ListenerHealthStatus.description_zh: 监听的服务器组健康检查状态列表

items.description_en: The health check status of a server group that is associated with the listener
items.description_zh: 监听的服务器组健康检查状态结构

ActionType.description_en:
The type of action for the server group. Valid values:

`ForwardGroup`: Forwards traffic to the server group.

`TrafficMirror`: Mirrors traffic to the server group
ActionType.description_zh:
服务器组使用类型。取值：

ForwardGroup：转发至服务器组。
TrafficMirror：流量镜像至服务器组

HealthCheckEnabled.description_en: Indicates whether health checks are enabled. A value of `on` indicates that they are enabled
HealthCheckEnabled.description_zh: 健康检查开启状态。取值： on，表示开启健康检查

NonNormalServers.description_en: A list of unhealthy backend servers
NonNormalServers.description_zh: 非正常状态的后端服务器列表

items.description_en: The details of an unhealthy backend server
items.description_zh: 非正常状态的后端服务器列表

Port.description_en: The port of the backend server

Reason.description_en: The reason why the backend server is unhealthy

ActualResponse.description_en:
The actual response code returned by the backend server. For example, `302`.

This parameter is returned only when `ReasonCode` is set to `RESPONSE_MISMATCH`
ActualResponse.description_zh:
后端服务器实际的返回码信息，例如，302。

ReasonCode为RESPONSE_MISMATCH才该返回值
ActualResponse.title_en: 后端实际的返回码信息
ActualResponse.title_zh: 后端实际的返回码信息

ExpectedResponse.description_en:
The expected response code from the backend server.

You can specify multiple values. Separate them with commas (`,`).

This parameter is returned only when `ReasonCode` is set to `RESPONSE_MISMATCH`
ExpectedResponse.description_zh:
用户预期的后端服务器返回码信息。

取值：HTTP_2xx、HTTP_3xx、HTTP_4xx和HTTP_5xx。多个返回码之间用半角逗号（,）分隔。

ReasonCode为RESPONSE_MISMATCH才返回该值
ExpectedResponse.title_en: 用户预期的后端返回码信息
ExpectedResponse.title_zh: 用户预期的后端返回码信息

ReasonCode.description_en:
The detailed reason why the backend server is in an abnormal `Status`.
This parameter is returned only for HTTP and HTTPS listeners and forwarding rules.

`CONNECT_TIMEOUT`: The connection to the backend server timed out during a health check.

`CONNECT_FAILED`: The connection to the backend server failed during a health check.

`RECV_RESPONSE_FAILED`: A response was not received from the backend server during a health check.

`RECV_RESPONSE_TIMEOUT`: The health check timed out while waiting for a response from the backend server.

`SEND_REQUEST_FAILED`: The health check request failed to be sent to the backend server.

`SEND_REQUEST_TIMEOUT`: The health check timed out while sending a request to the backend server.

`RESPONSE_FORMAT_ERROR`: The health check response from the backend server was malformed.

`RESPONSE_MISMATCH`: The health check response code from the backend server did not match the expected code
ReasonCode.description_zh:
Status为异常状态时的详细原因。
目前仅HTTP和HTTPS的监听与转发规则支持查看异常状态原因：
CONNECT_TIMEOUT：负载均衡健康检查时向后端服务器建立连接超时。

CONNECT_FAILED：负载均衡健康检查时向后端服务器建立连接失败。

RECV_RESPONSE_FAILED：负载均衡健康检查时从后端服务器接收响应失败。

RECV_RESPONSE_TIMEOUT：负载均衡健康检查时从后端服务器接收响应超时。

SEND_REQUEST_FAILED：负载均衡健康检查时向后端服务器发送请求失败。

SEND_REQUEST_TIMEOUT：负载均衡健康检查时向后端服务器发送请求超时。

RESPONSE_FORMAT_ERROR：负载均衡健康检查时从后端服务器接收响应格式错误。

RESPONSE_MISMATCH：负载均衡健康检查时从后端服务器接收的响应码与预期配置返回码不一致

Reason.title_en: status为非正常状态时的详细异常原因
Reason.title_zh: status为非正常状态时的详细异常原因

ServerId.description_en: The ID of the backend server

ServerIp.description_en: The IP address of the backend server

Status.description_en:
The health check status. Valid values:

`Initial`: The server is being initialized. Although health checks are configured, the first result has not yet been received.

`Unhealthy`: The server has failed multiple consecutive health checks.

`Unused`: The server is not in use. This can occur if its weight is set to 0, or if cross-zone load balancing is disabled and the server is in a different availability zone than the ALB instance.

`Unavailable`: Health checks are disabled for this server
Status.description_zh:
健康检查状态。取值：

Initial：初始化中，表示负载均衡实例配置了健康检查，但查不到数据。

Unhealthy：异常，表示连续上报不健康的状态。

Unused：未使用，表示后端服务器的权重为 0 或当您设置关闭跨 AZ 负载均衡，且后端服务器与 ALB 不在相同可用区。

Unavailable：未开启，表示未开启健康检查

NextToken.description_en:
The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results.

If this parameter is empty, all results have been returned.

If a value is returned, pass it in the next request to retrieve the next page of results
NextToken.description_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
如果NextToken为空表示没有下一次查询。
如果NextToken有返回值，该取值表示下一次查询开始的令牌
